تستخبري (form X)
# تَسْتَخْبِرِي (tastaḵbirī) /tas.tax.bi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
# تُسْتَخْبَرِي (tustaḵbarī) /tus.tax.ba.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
